title: Wayfare Pass Member Detour Credit (Wayfare Rides)
content:
**Member benefit schedule.** On a detoured trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** whose fare was lengthened by the driver, a member detour credit follows the **Wayfare Pass (rider membership)** membership in force at the request: its status, and the membership fee charges booked on it in the last 6 months.

| Membership in force at the request | Membership fee charges booked on it in the last 6 months | Member detour credit |
|---|---|---|
| trial, active or pending cancellation status | $100.00 or more (member-credit fee floor) | $2.00 (full member detour credit) |
| trial, active or pending cancellation status | less than $100.00 | $1.00 (part member detour credit) |
| any other rider | — | none |

A membership in trial, active or pending cancellation status on which membership fee charges of at least $100.00 were booked in the last 6 months gives the full member detour credit of $2.00; one in those statuses with smaller fee charges in the last 6 months gives the part member detour credit of $1.00; any other rider gets none.

## Cases (hypothetical memberships)

- Active membership with $129.90 in fee charges in the last 6 months: $2.00.
- Trial membership with no fee charges yet: in a qualifying status with $0.00 in fees, so $1.00.
- Pending cancellation with exactly $100.00 in fee charges: $2.00.
- Paused membership with $300.00 in fee charges: none.
- No membership in force at the request: none.
